evaluations.title: Only Website is offered for new production runs
evaluations.pass: Intake exposes one Website target and contains no production Web app or iOS claim.

evaluations.title: Server rejects new non-website generation
evaluations.pass: Every create, start, retry, and rebuild boundary rejects web-app and ios-app without creating build artifacts.

evaluations.title: Legacy non-website records are read-only compatible
evaluations.pass: Legacy records load and export without silent Page IR reinterpretation, are marked experimental, and cannot resume/continue generation, rebuild, repair, edit, or generate/place assets.

evaluations.title: Versioned Page IR contracts are closed
evaluations.pass: Valid v1 fixtures parse and unknown fields, versions, discriminants, or node kinds fail.

evaluations.title: Executable and path-bearing payloads fail closed
evaluations.pass: HTML, script, style, handler, traversal, absolute path, shell, oversized data URL, and hostile URL fixtures are rejected.

evaluations.title: Page IR referential integrity
evaluations.pass: Duplicate IDs, dangling tokens/assets/actions, invalid nesting, and missing required landmarks fail.

evaluations.title: Derivation accepts only approved bound inputs
evaluations.pass: Draft, superseded, hash-mismatched, or cross-run inputs cannot produce Page IR.

evaluations.title: Deterministic compiler produces identical bytes
evaluations.pass: Ten clean compiles per corpus fixture produce identical file inventories and SHA-256 values.

evaluations.title: Stable editor identity survives compilation and responsive rendering
evaluations.pass: Every editable rendered element has one unique Page IR-derived ID at all viewports and across recompiles.

evaluations.title: Layout authority is singular and immutable
evaluations.pass: Creation records one authority; mixed output and authority changes on retry or resume are rejected.

evaluations.title: Template fallback creates a separate linked run
evaluations.pass: A template fallback creates a separately identified linked template-v1 run; the original Page IR run, authority, and failure remain unchanged.

evaluations.title: First failing build publishes no site
evaluations.pass: An injected blocking failure leaves the served site and live gate report absent while preserving one diagnostic candidate within the frozen retention bounds.

evaluations.title: Failing rebuild preserves last-known-good bytes
evaluations.pass: The pre-run and post-failure live site inventory, live gate-report path, bytes, and hashes are identical; only the candidate-scoped report may change.

evaluations.title: Repair writes candidate only and reruns full gates
evaluations.pass: Write tracing shows no live or approved-artifact mutation and every repair is followed by the full suite.

evaluations.title: Promotion is atomic and restorable
evaluations.pass: Failures before, between, and after promotion leave either the complete old live bundle and old canonical gate report or the complete gated candidate bundle and its report, never a partial or cross-version mix.

evaluations.title: Candidate state and manifest transitions are valid
evaluations.pass: Only allowed transitions parse; manifest inventory, regular-file checks, 100 MiB limit, one-per-run and 24-hour retention bounds, and hashes match the candidate.

evaluations.title: Crash recovery preserves the last-known-good site
evaluations.pass: A crash injected at every lifecycle transition resumes or abandons safely without deleting the prior live site.

evaluations.title: Concurrent builds and mutations serialize under one authority
evaluations.pass: Interleaved build, promotion, edit, token, asset, and motion operations cannot lose updates or mix manifests.

evaluations.title: Promotion invalidates visual approval after commit
evaluations.pass: Rejected candidates preserve approval; promoted candidates invalidate it, bind the new visual-QA artifact to the promoted hash, and block release/export/client handoff until re-approved.

evaluations.title: Mutation capabilities map to sufficient gates
evaluations.pass: Content, token/style, asset, structure, link/action, motion, mixed, and unknown cases choose the registered suite; each route catches its seeded defect.

evaluations.title: Rejected mutation restores complete state
evaluations.pass: Persisted Page IR, candidate files, candidate-scoped report, live site bundle, and canonical live report return byte-for-byte as applicable, including when restorative gates crash.

evaluations.title: Approval invalidation ordering remains correct
evaluations.pass: Invalidation occurs after gate pass and commit, never for a rejected mutation.

evaluations.title: Page IR edits remain authoritative through rebuild
evaluations.pass: A supported edit changes validated Page IR, recompiles through a candidate, survives restart and rebuild, and never directly mutates compiled output; unsupported IR capabilities fail without changing either authority.

evaluations.title: Reconnect and resume do not repeat completed model work
evaluations.pass: Recorded model call count remains zero when required checkpoints and valid hashes already exist.

evaluations.title: Retry allowance lifecycle is transactional
evaluations.pass: Pre-repair failures do not consume allowance; one completed repair attempt cannot be double-spent.

evaluations.title: Static and no-JavaScript website contract
evaluations.pass: Core content, navigation, and primary action remain available with JavaScript disabled for every corpus fixture.

evaluations.title: Responsive layout and accessibility
evaluations.pass: At all frozen viewports, every fixture passes mobile layout, keyboard and reduced-motion checks, has zero serious/critical findings from the repository-pinned axe ruleset, and passes rendered WCAG AA contrast.

evaluations.title: Assets, console, and performance gates
evaluations.pass: All fixtures pass asset and console-error gates with no hidden remote dependency and stay below 900 KiB total, 500 KiB images, and 2000ms DOMContentLoaded at 4x CPU throttle.

evaluations.title: Single composer and bounded long-prompt behavior
evaluations.pass: One prompt surface is present; long content grows from 120px to min(360px, 50dvh), scrolls internally at the cap, preserves focus, and leaves Start reachable.

evaluations.title: Attempt focus, 403 recovery, and prompt preservation
evaluations.pass: Start announces progress; a forced 403 focuses an accurate error and Retry/Edit prompt preserve the submitted state.

evaluations.title: Upload failure classification and idempotent retry
evaluations.pass: Authorization, validation, and transport errors are distinct; selected files remain safe and retry reuses the request identity.

evaluations.title: Workbench controls remain accessible and stable
evaluations.pass: Resize, width presets, collapse, reopen, labels, tooltips, keyboard flow, and touch targets pass at all viewports.

evaluations.title: Image library safety and provenance
evaluations.pass: Library, generation consent, retry, provenance, placement, replacement, and gate failure states remain operable.

evaluations.title: Current 403 path is reproduced before opening a bug
evaluations.pass: A valid same-origin Start and upload request succeed; hostile origin variants still return 403. Any valid-path 403 creates a captured P0 defect without weakening the guard.

evaluations.title: Website-purpose topology is materially appropriate
evaluations.pass: Each corpus fixture scores at least 3 for purpose topology and no non-brochure fixture is a restyled local-service skeleton.

evaluations.title: Client specificity and visual quality meet the rubric
evaluations.pass: All rubric dimensions are at least 3, the mean is at least 3.2, and no automatic rejection applies.

evaluations.title: Reference alignment is synthesized rather than copied
evaluations.pass: Approved reference lessons are visible and traceable while branding and composition remain client-owned.

evaluations.title: Build and approval provenance is complete
evaluations.pass: All required input, IR, compiler, candidate, gate, promotion, fallback, and review hashes validate.

evaluations.title: Failure states are distinguishable
evaluations.pass: Candidate, repair, gate, promotion, and recovery failures produce distinct user-visible states and structured events.

evaluations.title: Rollout flag and kill switch preserve run authority
evaluations.pass: Changing the new-run default affects only future runs and cannot rewrite or silently reroute an existing run.

evaluations.title: Qualification packet blocks incomplete promotion
evaluations.pass: Missing fixture, result, hash, P0 disposition, or named human approval prevents default-on status.

evaluations.title: Local API and iframe security boundaries do not regress
evaluations.pass: Existing same-origin, loopback, bearer-client, upload, and iframe hostile variants continue to fail closed.

evaluations.title: Candidate manifest rejects unsafe filesystem objects
evaluations.pass: Traversal, absolute path, symlink, device, oversized, hash-mismatched, missing, and unexpected-file fixtures fail before promotion.

evaluations.title: Deterministic evaluation needs no live credential
evaluations.pass: The merge-blocking contract, compiler, candidate, replay, and security suite passes with provider credentials absent.
